context:
Goal: drop the guard's false alarm on interpreter strings (#1186) without opening a hole.
Problem (rule): #1186's round 3 found negative net value, so decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 parks it until you decide. It opens two holes main refuses: a frozen path in a shell variable inside `python3 -c` or `node -e`, and a frozen path joined into a string in a node -e script (`'cp ' + p`).
Based on (measured): the round 3 reviewer's scratch probe shows a one-line change in guard_frozen.py closes the first hole (review record 6762046224 on #1186); the second needs the js whole-script fallback to refuse when it cannot read a string join.
Based on (read): decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 gives a held change no fix lane until the owner decides.
Departs from: main — #1186 would ship with one fix pass for both holes, past its three rounds.
Meanwhile: #1186 stays parked and its lane waits; #1668 is unstacked from it and does not wait.

options.gain: The false alarm goes, and both holes close before merge.
options.how: The one-line change plus a js fallback that refuses an unread string join. A test-author writes red cases for both first, a Sonnet builder fixes, then a Sonnet fix check with the net-value test.
options.label: Allow one fix pass for both holes (Recommended)
options.lose: One more review cycle past the cap, and a fix larger than one line.

ref: PR #1186; review record 6762046224 on #1186; decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3; #1668 moves off #1186 meanwhile
reply: Routed 09:07 CST Nov 10 to the coordinator: pick a, one fix pass for both holes in #1186. Home: decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 (the held change gets one fix lane).
title: Let a parked PR (#1186) get one fix pass for two holes past its three review rounds?
why: Decides whether the guard's false alarm on interpreter strings goes this week; a held PR gets no fix lane until you decide.
